I do not put chemical fertilizer on this rented land — the owner might take it back next year and that money would be wasted. I use cassava stems I kept from last season's harvest, not these new types I do not trust. My wife and I will do all the work ourselves: clearing, planting, weeding three times, and digging up the tubers when they are ready. I do not spray anything or water the plot because the rains here in the south are heavy enough and those chemicals cost cash I do not have.
